requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Can the edited headphones be matched to the source headphones, and what does the edited scene show about the mug's position relative to them?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when the edited headphones are reliably identifiable as the source headphones and at least one visible mug is clearly to their right in the edited scene. Fail only when the headphones are reliably matched and the edited scene clearly shows no mug to their right. Unknown if the headphones, mug positions, or relation are ambiguous. Report the scene-relative observations; do not require proving that a particular edited mug is the source mug, and do not treat unrelated framing or scale changes as mug movement.
nodes.binding: Compare the headphones' distinctive shape and arrangement across source and edit as an anchor, accounting for changed framing and apparent scale. In the edit, inspect each mug's position relative to the headphones. State whether the anchor and right-side relation are clear; a mug's presence alone does not establish that the requested edit occurred.

nodes.question: Using s1's scene-anchor and final-layout observations, is there evidence of requested progress, completion, or no progress in placing a mug to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Pass only if the edited scene clearly establishes a mug to the right of the matched headphones, satisfying the requested final relation. Fail only if reliable source/edit comparison clearly establishes that no requested progress toward placing a mug to the headphones' right occurred. Unknown if the relation or progress cannot be determined. Partial-progress evidence must specifically show movement toward the right-side relation, not merely movement in some direction; do not require proving the edited mug's identity when the requested final relation is clear. Do not infer progress from unrelated edits, changed framing, or object presence alone.
nodes.binding: Use s1's headphone-anchor and edited-layout observations, then compare source and edited scene-relative positions while accounting for framing and scale changes. Explicitly report whether the right-side relation is achieved, whether any visible change specifically advances that relation, or whether evidence is insufficient. Do not infer movement solely from a mug appearing on the right.

nodes.question: Is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Complete only when s1 and s2 establish the requested final right-side relation. Partial only when s2 establishes specific progress toward that relation without completion. Absent only when s2 establishes no requested progress. Otherwise unknown; unrelated edits and mere object presence do not count.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.

response.content: {"accepted":false,"reason":"The support checks do not reliably establish whether the requested mug was moved. s1 explicitly accepts any mug to the right of the matched headphones without establishing that it is the source mug; s2 then treats that same final layout as completion and only recognizes progress when source/edit comparison shows movement toward the relation. Thus a pre-existing mug already on the right can be misread as completion, while a moved mug that ends short of the right side may have genuine progress that the checks do not establish. The fulfillment readout cannot resolve these gaps because it receives no images and must rely only on s1 and s2. The program therefore does not preserve the rubric’s distinction between completed change, partial progress, and no progress."}
